description: Address semantic review findings in media_player.py: make _send_command return bool, fix mute state tracking, fix notification callback thread safety, add initial state poll, fix _ensure_connected reentrancy, and add local_name filter to manifest.
steps: Make _send_command return bool (True on success, False on failure). Guard optimistic state updates behind success check in all command methods.
Fix mute state tracking: track mute state separately, do not derive is_volume_muted from volume==0.
Fix notification callback thread safety: use hass.loop.call_soon_threadsafe for async_write_ha_state.
Add initial state poll: after _start_notifications succeeds, send build_get_status() to request current state.
Fix _ensure_connected reentrancy: replace boolean _connecting flag with asyncio.Lock.
Add local_name filter to manifest.json bluetooth matcher.
acceptance_criteria: _send_command returns True on success, False on failure
Optimistic state updates are guarded by _send_command return value
Mute state is tracked independently from volume level
Notification callback safely schedules state updates on the event loop
Initial state poll is sent after connection setup
Concurrent _ensure_connected calls wait rather than fail
manifest.json includes local_name filter for TCL
findings: All 6 review issues fixed. py_compile passes, 22 protocol tests pass. Constructor now takes hass parameter for thread-safe callback scheduling.
